Name: Clean Up Pam's Yard
Author: gmPoirier
Description:
A simple map mod to remove the garbage around Pam's trailer. Now uses Content Patcher instead of manually replacing game files

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*]Install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download the mod, unzip it, and place the [b][CP] Clean Up Pam's Yard[/b] folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
